items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt unit
items.note: An owner paid about $4,000 for a factory rebuilt unit.

items.t: StabiliTrak brakes a wheel or pulls the van on its own
items.job: Replace yaw rate or steering wheel position sensor; repair wiring
items.note: Owners report about $200 for a steering angle sensor and $400–$500 for a yaw sensor.

items.t: Power sliding door won't close, latch or stay shut
items.job: Repair sliding door roller, cable, motor or latch
items.note: An owner paid about $900 for a latch repair; a roller and adjustment was about C$230.

items.t: Door-ajar chime won't stop or false door warnings
items.job: Replace door-ajar switch or reset door sensors

items.t: ABS and traction lights from a wheel speed sensor
items.job: Replace front hub with wheel speed sensor

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum or play
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly

items.t: Rear air-leveling shocks fail
items.job: Replace rear air shocks or convert to standard shocks

items.t: Rear trailing arm can crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear trailing arm (recall)

items.t: Parking brake can slip and drag (recall)
items.job: Inspect parking brake; replace rear calipers if needed (recall)

items.t: Tire label shows wrong load data (recall)
items.job: Replace tire and loading label (recall)

items.t: Stalling or no-start from a wet connector under the driver's seat
items.job: Clean or repair corroded connector under driver's seat

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel pump module or level sender
items.note: An owner paid about $600 for a fuel level sensor.

items.t: Check engine light from a failed EGR valve
items.job: Replace EGR valve and reflash engine computer

items.t: Whistle under acceleration from the PCV tube
items.job: Replace PCV tube

items.t: Headlights and interior lights flicker
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Dash gauges stop working
items.job: Repair or replace instrument cluster

items.t: OnStar loses power
items.job: Replace OnStar communication interface module

items.t: Horn hard to sound
items.job: Install softer horn pad springs

items.t: Brake pulsation from warped front rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Worn tie rod ends cause looseness or clunks
items.job: Replace tie rod ends and align
items.note: An owner paid about $500 with sway bar bushings and alignment.

items.t: Oil and coolant leaks at the front of the engine
items.job: Replace coolant crossover gaskets and timing cover seals

items.t: Oil pan leak
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket

items.t: Cruise control stops working
items.job: Replace cruise control switch

items.t: Shift cable bushing breaks
items.job: Replace shift cable bushing
items.note: If the whole cable is bad, RepairPal estimates about $218–$258.

items.t: Transmission cooler line leak
items.job: Replace transmission cooler lines

items.t: Check engine light from a stuck-open thermostat
items.job: Replace thermostat and coolant temperature sensor

items.t: Rear wiper stops working
items.job: Replace rear wiper motor
